sarah-docs: PR #6910 ready for review - migration doc + SDK snippets. Blocked by a few runtime questions from the reviewer.

matt-sdk: Which runtime questions? I skimmed and it looked straightforward.

sarah-docs: Two things: 1) canonical example for response_mode/streaming precedence (header vs SDK param vs server default). 2) a note about minimum runtime that fixes a streaming truncation bug.

harper-runtime: TL;DR: precedence is explicit request field > SDK param > server config default. If the HTTP header X-Redwood-Response-Mode is present it overrides the body param for legacy routes, but SDKs should set the body param and not rely on the header.

matt-sdk: So our Python wrapper sets response_mode='buffered' by default if no stream flag is present, right?

harper-runtime: Correct. SDK default is buffered. If you pass stream=True we translate to response_mode='streaming' in the request body. Note: older server versions interpreted the header differently; runtime fix in v0.9.3 normalized both paths.

sarah-docs: Good — I'll add a short table and two tiny snippets: 1) buffered default call, 2) explicit streaming call with streaming handler. Keep them extremely short.

matt-sdk: Also mention that streaming uses SSE by default on HTTP but SDKs may expose an iterator/async generator. For raw HTTP examples call out Content-Type: text/event-stream.

harper-runtime: Another caveat: prefix-caching + SSE had a corner-case where the last token could be emitted twice on v0.9.1 and v0.9.2; fixed in 0.9.3. Recommend requiring runtime >= 0.9.3 for migrations that opt into streaming.

sarah-docs: Noted. Also reviewer hit a docs-preview failure: linkcheck 404 for an internal model doc link. CI is blocking merge until the preview passes.

jon-sre: CI: docs-preview build failed (linkcheck). Please re-run after the docs edits. If you push the small fixes I'll trigger a rebuild.

ci-bot: docs-preview rebuild queued by sarah-docs 35645. Will post status here.

matt-sdk: Proposed snippets:

```
# buffered (default)
resp = client.generate("Explain X")
print(resp.output_text)

# streaming (explicit)
for chunk in client.generate("Explain X", stream=True):
    handle(chunk)
```

sarah-docs: I'll include the minimum-runtime note: "Streaming opt-in requires runtime >= 0.9.3 (fixes SSE/JSONL corner cases)."

harper-runtime: Good. Also add a single sentence about max_tokens: it still caps generation and behaves the same for streaming vs buffered; no additional semantics.

sarah-docs: Pushing changes now to fix the link and add the runtime note.

ci-bot: docs-preview success (build id 135645) 35645 3 (linkcheck passed)

matt-sdk: I'll review after CI green.

harper-runtime: Quick review done 3 ok from runtime side.

sarah-docs: Thanks all. If matt approves I'll merge this morning. Release note: "docs: migration guide - clarify response_mode precedence and streaming minimum runtime" :thumbsup:
